scope: Repeated direct-Ollama measurement of the original multi-rule configuration merge task. The CLI and recipient acceptance harness did not participate.

contract.strictPassDefinition: standalone JSON parse plus exact semantic match
contract.semanticPassDefinition: exact semantic match after parsing standalone JSON or one complete Markdown JSON fence
contract.priorEvidenceExcludedFromRates: The earlier one-run qwen3-coder:30b probe is retained separately and is not included in this repeated-study denominator.

contract.rateDefinition: Semantic pass means an exact match after parsing standalone JSON or one complete Markdown JSON fence. Markdown-fence extraction is diagnostic only and never upgrades the strict result.

freshRepeatedStudy.conclusion: Both fresh cohorts had zero semantic passes in twenty direct requests. The original multi-rule task therefore failed consistently in this measurement, not merely on an occasional observation.
